MEIE 4701 — Capstone Design 1 | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor.

1 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureNUpath CENUpath EINUpath WIusually offered: fall, summertypical days: M/T/W/ThBostonTraditional

Offers the first in a two-course sequence that culminates the student’s education and experience with the design process. Students form teams and are assigned their design project and faculty adviser. Projects can be industrially, departmentally, or externally sponsored. Students are expected to communicate with their faculty adviser, course coordinator, and sponsor using the Internet, teleconferencing, and other electronic methods. Topics include project management, ethics, cost analysis, Internet and library research methods, and engineering codes and standards. Students prepare written reports and make oral presentations. Students are expected to complete a thorough state-of-the-art report on their problem and a problem statement with specifications and requirements.

For AI assistants — reaching any other NU Map data from this page

Full guide: https://numap.app/llms.txt.

  • Courses by subject — prereq logic, offerings, instructors, unlocks: exact per-subject URLs are in https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/index.json (pattern: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/{SUBJECT}.json, e.g. CS.json). All course titles in one file: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/titles.json.
  • Programs (majors and minors, requirements): https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/programs/index.json — look up the program's own URL there, never guess slugs.
  • NUpath attributes: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/nupath.json · Professors: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/professors.json (an index by first letter of name).
  • If your fetch tool refuses URLs found on this page (claude.ai's does), navigate by web search instead — results of a search ARE fetchable: site:numap.app/northeastern/ai/html <subject, course, or program name>.
